user_query: I have a brilliant business idea and I need your help to bring it to life. Can you generate a business plan for my idea and provide me with a catchy business name and a creative slogan to go along with it? I'm excited to see what you come up with!

TaskList.description: Gather information about the user's business idea and goals.
Research the market trends and potential competitors based on the user's business idea.
Generate a comprehensive business plan based on collected information and research.
Create a list of potential catchy business names.
Develop a creative slogan that reflects the essence of the business idea.
Compile the business plan, names, and slogans into a final document.
